title: How the research agent answers with sources
subtitle: A LangGraph agent searches with Tavily, scrapes top pages into ChromaDB, and has Llama on Groq write a cited report.

nodes.label: Researcher
nodes.detail: Types a question of 10 to 500 characters in the web page, or calls POST /research directly with an API key.

nodes.label: Research API
nodes.detail: Serves POST /research and a streaming WebSocket. Callers without a key get 10 requests a minute and 3 queries a day per IP.
nodes.tradeoff: Demo mode forces brief answers from at most 3 results, to protect what the code calls a $3 API budget.

nodes.label: Answer cache
nodes.detail: A repeated question returns at once from an in-memory cache keyed on a hash of the query, provider and depth.
nodes.tradeoff: It holds 500 answers and evicts the oldest first; it lives in one process and empties on restart.

nodes.label: Session memory
nodes.detail: Each session's messages go to Redis with a one-hour expiry, so follow-up questions keep their context.
nodes.tradeoff: If Redis is missing or down, it falls back to in-memory history.

nodes.label: LangGraph agent
nodes.detail: A state graph runs research, then scrape, then synthesize, passing one shared state of findings and scraped chunks.
nodes.tradeoff: After each step a router checks for errors and ends the run early rather than writing an answer from nothing.

nodes.label: Web search
nodes.detail: Tavily runs an advanced search for 5 results with raw page content, skipping facebook.com and twitter.com.
nodes.tradeoff: A failed search returns an empty list, so the run carries on without sources instead of crashing.

nodes.label: Page scraper
nodes.detail: Loads the top 3 result URLs in parallel, strips the HTML to text, and splits it into 1,000-character chunks with 200 overlap.
nodes.tradeoff: Each chunk keeps its source URL, which is what lets the final answer cite it.

nodes.label: Vector store
nodes.detail: Chunks are embedded on the CPU with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and stored in a ChromaDB collection for this session only.
nodes.tradeoff: Local embeddings need no API key; the 5 most similar chunks become the LLM's context.

nodes.label: Report writer
nodes.detail: Llama 3.3 70B on Groq gets the question plus the 5 retrieved chunks, each labelled with its source, and writes a structured report.
nodes.tradeoff: The prompt asks it to cite sources and to say where sources disagree.

flow.text: Asks what is new in solid-state batteries.
Checks the daily quota and the cache, then starts the agent.
Enters the research step of the state graph.
Tavily returns 5 results with their page content.
Scrapes the top 3 pages and splits them into overlapping chunks.
Embeds the chunks and stores them in this session's collection.
Writes a structured report from the 5 closest chunks, citing sources.
Gets the answer with a de-duplicated list of source links.

takeaways.text: Each session gets its own ChromaDB collection, so one user's scraped pages don't mix into another's answer.
A daily quota of 3, demo mode and an answer cache keep a public demo inside a small API budget.
Tool failures return empty results or an error state, and the graph routes any error straight to the end.
